snapshot.title: Forensic Image Capture — CAD-MDS01

lines.msg: Forensic image of CAD-MDS01 (10.72.30.20) captured via RCECD-F-21 (10.72.30.200) and stored on \10.72.30.200\forensics\cad_mds01_20261024_2135.img
Image verified: SHA-256 hash matches baseline from RCECD-F-21 (RCECD-F-21, ALI_20261024_193510)
Isolation confirmed: CAD-MDS01 (10.72.30.20) isolated from CAD-FW01 (10.72.30.10) via CYB-DR-1 (OPS-DR-1)
Backup restore request initiated: last clean backup (2025-12-31 23:59) on network share \10.72.30.200\backup\cad\
Access denied: missing CJIS incident report submission for 2026-10-24. Required for vendor access and restore approval.

CJIS incident report (RCECD-CYB-2026, C2) must be submitted to Indiana State Police via IDACS before any restore can proceed. TAC must complete the CJIS Security Incident Reporting form and send to state CSA.
Audit trail: RCECD-OPS-2026, Section 5, T-2 Contain — manual isolation and imaging completed per playbook
Image retention: 90 days per RCECD-F-21 policy (RCECD-SYS-2026, C3)

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms forensic containment and reveals the compliance barrier to restore. The Tech must recognize that CJIS reporting must be completed before any vendor access or restore is permitted.
